question: Why is renunciation hard without yoga but easy for yogis?
premises: renunciation is hard to obtain without yoga
a yoga-united sage attains brahman not after long time
without yoga renunciation is painful because actions are badly renounced
for yogis this is easily obtained
inference: yoga makes renunciation attainable and fruitful
uncertainties: fused sandhi compounds are analyzed as given, not split
plain_english: Renunciation is hard without yoga, but a yoga-united sage attains brahman without delay; for yogis this is easily obtained, while without yoga it is painful.
